metadata.prompt: Describe this image and judge whether it is physically reasonable.
metadata.reference: A photorealistic nature scene of a mountain stream cascading over mossy stepped rocks. Water flows downstream following the terrain, creating accurate white-water splashes, mist, and downstream ripples, natural daylight, no text, no watermark.
metadata.rationale: The water correctly follows gravity, terrain contours, and momentum conservation in its flow and splashes.
